body_lead: Gujarat Police launch AI-powered tool to strengthen NDPS case investigation and prosecution Summarized by AI; it may make mistakes. Check important info Gujarat Police have become the first in the country to develop an artificial intelligence-driven tool called ‘NARIT AI’ (Narcotics Analysis & RAG-based Investigation Tool), aimed at strengthening narcotics investigation and enforcement. According to Gujarat Police, NARIT AI is a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)-based system designed to assist law enforcement agencies in handling complex narcotics cases under the NDPS legal framework.
